string.text:
A two-handed artefact spectrometer put together by the Radar-1 engineers from a Veles housing, Western chips and parts of Monolith emitters. The probe-pistol goes in the right hand, the tablet with the screen in the left, a coiled cable between them.
While it is in your hands there is no weapon and no bolts: either you take the risk alone or your partner covers you. RMB: point the probe and take a reading.
Prototype: the screen and the detector part are not connected yet.
